title: Quiz: Training Systems and Distributed Training

questions.question: Which statement best captures data parallelism in machine learning systems?
options: It replicates the model and splits data batches across workers.
It is only about faster matrix multiplication.
It does not need fault tolerance because training is offline.
It can ignore the data loading path.

questions.question: Which statement best captures model parallelism in machine learning systems?
options: It does not need fault tolerance because training is offline.
It partitions model computation or parameters across devices.
It can ignore the data loading path.
It makes communication free when workers are identical.
